text:
Aisha (AE): Tess from MeridianCorp ran our pre-sales checklist and wants clarifications before we kick off a 30-day POC. Main asks: SP vs IdP initiated SAML flows, SLO support, SCIM delta vs full import performance, mapping Okta group hierarchies into our RBAC, domain ownership automation (CNAME preferred), and a POC cost sketch for hosted credits vs a short reserved Dedicated trial.

Eli (Sales Eng): Quick answers we can put in the doc: we support both SP-initiated and IdP-initiated SAML. For SLO: we support single logout via HTTP-Redirect or SOAP (SOAP rarely used) but there are caveats with IdP session caches. We'll include sample metadata + settings for common IdPs (Okta, Azure AD, Ping).

Tess (Customer): Important for us: our Okta setup uses nested groups and child groups for teams. We need a way to grant team-admins control over users in their scope without letting them create tenants or change billing. How granular can roles be?

Marco (Platform PM): Our RBAC model supports scoped roles and resource-level permissions. You can map an Okta group to a role scoped to a tenant or a namespace. Example: map `okta:eng-team-a` -> `tenant-admin:eng-a` which excludes billing perms. We'll add examples showing group-to-role mapping and the API call for granting scoped roles.

Priya (Security): Security checklist items from Meridian: KMS key access model (customer-managed), audit log retention 365 days preferred, SAML metadata signing algorithms (we support SHA256/384), need for signed assertions vs signed responses, and whether SCIM provisioning events are logged with actor identity.

Sam (SRE): SCIM performance notes: We currently support bulk CSV upload via the Console which converts to batched SCIM PATCHes under the hood. Rate limit defaults: 100 requests/min per tenant for SCIM POST/PATCH; when clients hit 429 we return Retry-After and an exponential backoff is recommended. For very large orgs we offer a temporary rate bump during imports with coordination.

Eli (Sales Eng): Sample SCIM bulk flow snippet for their IdP team:
```
POST /scim/v2/Bulk
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "failOnErrors": 0,
  "Operations": [
    {"method":"PATCH","path":"/Users/user-123","data":{ "Operations":[{"op":"replace","path":"emails","value":[{"value":"tess@meridian.com","primary":true}]}]}}
  ]
}
```

Priya (Security): About auditability: we surface SCIM events in the Audit log with actor (service principal or user) and object id. Logs are exportable to their SIEM via webhook or S3 sink. We can meet 365-day retention on enterprise contracts.

Tess (Customer): Domain proofing automation: we prefer CNAME because our infra uses ephemeral DNS for automation. Can you accept a wildcard verify flow for subdomains? Also ask: what's the verification polling cadence?

Sam (SRE): We accept CNAME or TXT verifications. Automated poll runs every 60s for the provisioning job for new domains; typical propagation will surface within a few minutes but depends on DNS TTL. For wildcard subdomains we require explicit CNAME records per wildcard entry; we do not accept a single wildcard token to claim a parent plus all children without explicit proof. We'll document the exact DNS records and an API endpoint to trigger a manual recheck.

Aisha (AE): Pricing sketch: we can offer Hosted credits for the POC (tokens + 2 dev seats). For Dedicated trial: minimum reserved is a 4-GPU pool for production-level throughput (monthly commit) but we can do a short-term Dedicated pilot under a contract addendum; Marco will draft numbers. Also call out data residency/EU egress implications if they want EU-only.

Marco (Platform PM): I'll prepare two decks: (1) Hosted POC cost using credits (recommended quick option), (2) Dedicated pilot delta including expected throughput for a 4-GPU pool and the migration runbook. Will include an estimate for SCIM/SSO testing hours and any professional services needed.

Eli (Sales Eng): Action items for Friday deliverable: - SAML metadata checklist + example IdP configs (Okta + Azure) - SLO caveats + sample logout flows - SCIM bulk import guide + rate-limit expectations and temp bump process - RBAC mapping examples for nested groups + API calls - Domain verification doc (CNAME/TXT + manual recheck endpoint) - Hosted vs Dedicated POC cost sketch + PS estimate

Priya (Security): I'll draft answers to the security questionnaire (they sent a PDF) and flag anything requiring legal/infra sign-off (KMS BYOK terms, log retention SLAs).

Tess (Customer): Timeline: can you get the doc + sample configs by Thursday EOD? We want internal sign-off and then schedule a technical kickoff the following Monday.

Aisha (AE): Let's aim for Thursday EOD. Eli and Priya, collaborate on the security + SCIM config snippets. Marco, ping @aisha if Dedicated numbers look like they need approvals. Sam, please include the manual recheck API path in the domain doc.
